## 72-Hour Winter Storm Preparedness for Montreal

Preparing an emergency kit is crucial for a family of four to safely navigate a severe winter storm in Montreal for up to 72 hours. This kit focuses on essential supplies for warmth, sustenance, safety, and communication in case of power outages and isolation.

## Emergency Kit Contents for a Family of Four

Here are the essential items to include in your 72-hour emergency kit:

### Water & Food
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Water:** At least 4 liters per person per day (48 liters total for 4 people, 3 days). Include some for hygiene.
- **Non-perishable food:** Easy-to-prepare items like canned goods, energy bars, dried fruit, nuts, and comfort foods. Manual can opener needed.
- **Baby formula/food:** If applicable.
- **Pet food:** If applicable.

### Warmth & Shelter
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/thermometer-half.svg
- **Warm blankets or sleeping bags:** One per person.
- **Extra layers of warm clothing:** Hats, gloves, scarves, thermal underwear, wool socks.
- **Waterproof matches or lighter:** For emergency heat (if safe to use) or cooking.
- **Tent or tarp:** For emergency shelter or to create a warm zone within the home.

### Light & Power
- **Flashlights:** At least two, with extra batteries.
- **Headlamps:** Hands-free lighting.
- **Battery-powered or crank radio:** With extra batteries.
- **Power bank:** Fully charged, for mobile devices.
- **Car charger:** For mobile devices.

### First Aid & Safety
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bandaid.svg
- **Comprehensive first-aid kit:** Including pain relievers, antiseptic wipes, bandages, gauze, medical tape.
- **Prescription medications:** At least a 7-day supply.
- **Whistle:** To signal for help.
- **Multi-tool or utility knife.**
- **Dust masks:** To filter contaminated air.

### Communication & Documents
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/phone.svg
- **Fully charged mobile phones.**
- **Important documents:** Copies of identification, insurance policies, bank records, stored in a waterproof bag.
- **Cash:** Small bills, as ATMs and electronic payments may not work.

### Hygiene & Other Essentials
- **Toiletries:** Toothbrushes, toothpaste, soap, hand sanitizer.
- **Moist towelettes, garbage bags, and plastic ties:** For personal sanitation.
- **Books, games, or activities:** To keep children occupied.
- **Shovel:** For clearing snow.
- **Road salt or sand:** For traction on icy surfaces.

## Quick Actions

- **City of Montreal Emergency Services:** [Button: Montreal Urgence](https://montreal.ca/en/topics/emergency-preparedness)
